mission: Turn the accepted exact-SHA evidence layer into a bounded federated control loop across KEB, DOW and cryoplant child authority without transferring engineering authority to parent repositories.

fixed_goalpost.goalpost_rule: V2-G1 through V2-G10 are fixed for this scope. Enhancements do not change the denominator; material expansion requires a new versioned scope.

keb.required_runtime_rule: PASS requires exact head SHA, receipt digest and executed_steps > 0

flow_semantics.feedforward: CONTROL decision emits bounded trigger or next action
flow_semantics.feedback: federated or child disposition returns to CONTROL before any next execution
flow_semantics.wait: missing prerequisite is an explicit controller state, not a code failure

gates.name: v1_control_baseline_imported
gates.exit: v1 8/8 acceptance and CONTROL cleanup are validated

gates.name: keb_dow_child_contracts_bound
gates.exit: three authority contracts are bound without authority leakage

gates.name: controller_state_machine_executable
gates.exit: exact-SHA workflow executes WAIT/TRIGGER/DISPOSITION semantics >0 steps

gates.name: exact_keb_receipt_intake
gates.exit: producer tuple, digest, result and positive runtime evidence are validated or explicitly rejected/deferred

gates.name: dow_challenge_and_disposition
gates.exit: DOW emits one ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER receipt bound to producer and DOW exact head

gates.name: cryoplant_child_reentry
gates.exit: child consumes exact DOW receipt and records ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER without authority leakage

gates.name: feedback_to_bounded_next_action
gates.exit: child feedback re-enters controller and produces WAIT/REPAIR/REPEAT/PROMOTE action

gates.name: measured_scheduler_telemetry
gates.exit: queue, execute, blocker-age and dependency/fan-out features are measured; PCA is used only when statistically justified

gates.name: distinct_sha_repeat_and_control
gates.exit: closed loop repeats on a second distinct exact SHA with append-only history, owner, cadence and re-entry rule
